title: Pied vs common kingfisher: two ways to fish
caption:
Both live along Indian rivers, but they fish in completely different ways.

Common kingfishers nest at the end of tunnels they dig in riverbanks, usually 15 to 30 cm long.

Source: Animal Diversity Web (Ceryle rudis, Alcedo atthis). Footage: pied kingfisher, Queen Elizabeth NP; common kingfisher. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
